title: ScheduleSeriesResponse
description: A [Schedule Series](/api-reference/schedule-management/models/schedule-series) representing one time series within a schedule version (e.g. one internal or external trade).

acceptance_level.description: Highest acceptance level reached by the parent version: empty string, `ack`, `ano`, `par`, or `cnf`.
acceptance_level.title: Acceptance Level

created_ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the parent version was created.
created_ts.title: Created Ts

interval_statuses.description: Per-interval status map. Always `null` — market-access tracks status at version granularity, not per interval.
interval_statuses.title: Interval Statuses

last_modified_ts.description: ISO 8601 datetime of the parent version's most recent status change.
last_modified_ts.title: Last Modified Ts

spec.description: Full series specification including identifiers, type, and interval data.

status.description: Processing status of the parent version. `created` before submission, then the verbatim market status: `submitted`, `ack_positive`, `ack_negative`, `ack_partial`, `icnf`, `dacnf`, `cnf`, `cnf_partial`, or `fcnf`.
status.title: Status

time_series_uid.description: Time series identifier used in the ESS/CIM document.
time_series_uid.title: Time Series Uid

uid.description: Unique identifier for this series record.
uid.title: Uid

version.description: Version number of the parent schedule version.
version.title: Version

ScheduleSeriesDataPoint.description: One interval of a schedule series: a timestamp and its power amount.

amount.description: Power value for the interval, in MW.
amount.title: Amount

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC start of the interval.
ts.title: Ts

ScheduleSeriesDataPoint.title: ScheduleSeriesDataPoint

ScheduleSeriesIds.description: EIC identifiers locating a series in the area/party exchange.

in_area.description: EIC Y code of the receiving control area.
in_area.title: In Area

in_party.description: EIC X code of the receiving party (balance responsible party).
in_party.title: In Party

out_area.description: EIC Y code of the sending control area.
out_area.title: Out Area

out_party.description: EIC X code of the sending party (balance responsible party).
out_party.title: Out Party

ScheduleSeriesIds.title: ScheduleSeriesIds

ScheduleSeriesSpec.description: Full series specification: identifiers, type, and interval data.

data.description: Interval data points, one per slot, ordered from the start of the delivery day.
data.title: Data

ids.description: EIC identifiers for the series exchange.

ScheduleSeriesSpec.title: ScheduleSeriesSpec
